original_requirement:
# Piezo Buzzer

## Project Description
This is a simple Arduino project that uses piezoelectric buzzer to play 262Hz tone.

## Hardware Components
- Arduino Uno
- Piezoelectric buzzer

## Circuit Description
The piezo buzzer is connected to the Arduino. The positive pin is connected to pin2, the negative pin to gnd1.

## Expected Behavior
When the Arduino powers up, it should:
1. Set the pin mode as OUTPUT
2. Continuously play 262Hz tone

## Success Criteria
The test is successful when:
1. Piezo buzzer runs successfuly

## Notes for Implementation
- In the loop function, make buzzer play 262Hz tone

## Variants
There may be variants with buzzer, GND pin number and the pitch of the sound being played.
Given circuit (must preserve wiring):
{
    "version": 1.0,
    "author": "Blind Author",
    "description": "Play tone with piezo buzzer",
    "parts": [
        {
            "type": "wokwi-arduino-uno",
            "id": "arduino uno1",
            "top": -9,
            "left": -19.8,
            "attrs": {}
        },
        {
            "type": "wokwi-buzzer",
            "id": "piezoelectric buzzer1",
            "top": -141.6,
            "left": 97.8,
            "attrs": {
                "volume": "0.1"
            }
        }
    ],
    "connections": [
        [
            "piezoelectric buzzer1:1",
            "arduino uno1:GND.1",
            "green",
            [
                "v0"
            ]
        ],
        [
            "piezoelectric buzzer1:2",
            "arduino uno1:2",
            "green",
            [
                "v0"
            ]
        ]
    ],
    "dependencies": {}
}
